entities.summary: Wang Chonghui was a prominent Chinese jurist, diplomat and politician who served the Republic of China from its foundation in 1912 until his death in 1958. He was a close associate of the republic's founding father, Sun Yat-sen, an active member of the Kuomintang, and a judge on the Permanent Court of International Justice in the Hague.
